lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used cars. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: You narrate a standalone episode about Kostya ferrying a car 900 km overnight. Deadpan, dry irony; numbers said fully. «Марк Два» is the Toyota Mark II. Line about documents: clear, useful, calm.

kostya.profile: Kostya — a young Russian guy in his 20s, friendly, nervous but determined, doing his first long car delivery; glasses and a yellow scarf.
kostya.notes: Line 1: excited, decisive. Line 2: calm, firm, showing proof. Line 3: tired at night, then shouting at a truck. Line 4: surprised, amused. Line 5: polite, confident. Line 6: short, proud.

denis.profile: Denis — a slick Russian car seller in his 30s, sunglasses at night, smooth and pushy.
denis.notes: Line 1: pushy, tries to raise the price. Line 2: reluctant, sour, gives in.

lyuba.profile: Aunt Lyuba — a warm, kind Russian woman in her 50s running a 24-hour roadside café at night, caring and motherly.
lyuba.notes: Line 1: caring, worried. Line 2: laughing softly, about her cat.

insp.profile: Inspector Sokolov — a Russian traffic police officer in his 40s, strict official tone that turns into genuine curiosity.
insp.notes: Line 1: official, strict. Line 2: satisfied, then curious. Line 3: shocked, envious, then eager.
